phrases.latin: Per angiporta oppidī clīvōsa, inter domōs albās tēgulīsque rubrīs tēctās, in mediam āream dēscendērunt
phrases.english: Down the town’s steep lanes, between white houses with red tiled roofs, they went down to the main square
phrases.source: Libellus II, Sintra: castellum et puteus

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 173.

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
